Oh, I wish I had popcorn as I watch the Null Guardian rip you to pieces!|audio = Null&VoidN2Wave25-1.ogg|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 25 ([[Banlands]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Null Guardian''' was a major boss that appeared in [[Banlands]]. Served as its final boss for the second night of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had far higher health than the [[Null Commander]] and only walked slightly slower than it. It also had the [[Stun Immunity]]. The '''Null Guardian''' had four abilities. #The first ability, ''Cosmic Spear'', made it rain down comets on towers and units. This targeted up to 10 towers and units, stunning any hit for 2 second or dealing 1,500 damage to it. #The second ability, ''Null Bubble'', had it form a bubble of void around a tower. This applied a 25% [[Range Debuff]] to any tower inside of it. #The third ability, ''Summon Clones'', had it summoned three [[Null Guardian Clone]]s. #The fourth ability, ''Lane Switch'', had it teleport to the adjacent path. #The last ability, ''Null Aura'', which happened when it reaches half of its health. This made it slam the ground, changing its animations and creating an aura with a radius of 12. This aura will apply a 15% [[Firerate Buff]] to any tower with it, as long as the tower is in the visible circle. This can stack with other [[Firerate Buff]]s. ==Logbook Description== "''The Null Guardian has existed within the Nil Zone since before the Old World, appointed to this role by the Rift Walker himself. He patrols endlessly, destroying any who enter the "Place Between Realms". The Guardian is connected to the chaotic energy of the Nil Zone, allowing him to perceive and experience the realm's history within it.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Guardian''' is a heavily armored entity with black skin and purple eyes. Its armor consists of a chestplate, helmet, shoulder-pads leggings and arm armor, with only certain parts of its body like its face being exposed. On its hands, it has a few fingers with electricity coming out of them. In the middle of its torso, it has a ball of dark energy that has purple lightning around it. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Banlands]] is listed instead. *The '''Null Guardian''' can be taken down quite effectively by towers like the [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]]. **Support towers like the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be helpful at boosting the statistics of your towers. *The '''Null Guardian''' summons in three [[Null Guardian Clone]]s which have a high amount of health. **While they are clones, they do not keep the '''Null Guardian's''' [[Boss]] attribute. This means they are more prone to various effects in the game. This makes the [[Hacker]] useful here, as it can convert these clones into friendly clones. *The '''Null Guardian''' is one of the faster boss enemies in the game, making stalling towers useful against it, though as it is a [[Boss]] most forms of stalling will not work on it. **Freezing towers can be useful here as while [[Boss]] enemies are immune to the freeze, they only gain a partial immunity to its chillness. **Similarly, stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] are useful, as they still get slowed down. *There are a few curses which can be taken to help take down the '''Null Guardian'''. **While [[Temperance]] does apply [[Mutation]], this will have no effect on the '''Null Guardian''' as it only spawns once. This means the [[Stun Immunity]] given to towers can be very helpful here. ***If taken on Wave 25, the [[Mutation]] modifier will do nothing as there is no wave past Wave 25, making it only boost rewards by 20%. **[[The Chariot]] can be useful as it boosts the damage and firerate of towers at the final wave. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} NullGuardianWalk.gif|Walking animation (25 October 2025 – Present) NullGuardianSpear.gif|''Cosmic Spear'' animation (25 October 2025 – Present) NullGuardianBubble.gif|''Null Bubble'' animation (25 October 2025 – Present) NullGuardianSummon.gif|''Summon Clones'' animation (25 October 2025 – Present) NullGuardianTeleport.gif|''Lane Switch'' animation (25 October 2025 – Present) NullGuardianRage.gif|{{Color|PhaseTwo|Null Aura}} animation (25 October 2025 – Present) NullGuardianRageWalk.gif|{{Color|PhaseTwo|Null Aura}} walking animation (25 October 2025 – Present) NullGuardianDeath.gif|Death animation (25 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNullGuardian.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, death animation (25 October 2025 – Present) CorpseNullGuardian2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, walk animation (25 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} Night2Promo.png|'''Null Guardian''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} NullVoidNight2Hour16.png|'''Null Guardian''' on the game icon.
